Study.com

Explore self-paced general education and upper-level courses. Your degree plan shows which course options fit.

Browse Study.com courses

Choose a degree plan to see where specific courses fit.

Study format
Self-paced. Current plans advertise unlimited monthly completions, with two concurrent Saver courses or three concurrent Pro courses.
Pricing
Published plans: College Saver $95/month and College Saver Pro $235/month. Confirm course inclusion and current checkout terms.
Assessments
Current official support describes required final exams as open-book and non-proctored. Course-specific assignments still apply.
Credit type
ACE or NCCRS recommendations for eligible courses under a credit-earning membership.

How the credit works

Before enrolling

  • Start with your degree plan to see the proposed receiving course or requirement.
  • Review any course-specific enrollment, equipment or assessment steps shown in your plan.
  • University decisions about your own records remain separate from published course matches.
